shared_tail.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة

notes: Two routes meet by «ح»; the four Zuhri sources and Aisha are written once after the last «ح», so they are the shared tail (rule 3)
Zuhri appears as «ابن شهاب» in one route and «الزهري» in the other; the two are not merged (rule 9)
«عن حديث، عائشة» : «حديث» (the report of) is not a name and is left out; the Prophet's wives' title is not written
